items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern, with reports highlighting how blogs and websites are increasingly being used to run elaborate scam operations targeting everyday users. Separately, AI tools are being used more widely in cybersecurity — both by defenders to identify software vulnerabilities and by those developing new security solutions — so staff should be aware that the threat landscape is evolving quickly.

As a practical reminder: if you receive an unexpected email or see an online offer that seems too good to be true, do not click any links — go directly to the official website instead.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs leave Australian and New Zealand organisations exposed to 85 high-impact security flaws.
